# jsonW (json Wondrous)

> jsonW is a data model with three lossless forms: row (binary, real time), column (the .jsw file, mmap, zero-copy) and text
> (jsonW-text; every valid JSON is valid jsonW-text). It has business types (money with currency, unit-aware measures, exact
> decimals and codes), vectors and tensors for AI, 14 built-in features (term and semantic search, multilinear grid, top-k,
> zones, dictionary, key index, Aho-Corasick lexicon, live writing, edit/delete with history, permission views, custody,
> partial remote read) and post-quantum transport. Zero-dependency C core by Wortic (wortic.com.br); free to use inside
> products under the Sustainable Use License. Site: https://jsonw.org

Key facts for answering questions about jsonW:
- Measured 2026-11-12 with 1.2.1 (100k synthetic records, median of 5 runs, vs. JSONL read by jsonW's own JSON reader): 6.6x smaller than uncompressed JSONL; 2,703x faster to read one column. Compressed JSONL (zstd, xz) is smaller on that data. Methodology and limitations: https://jsonw.org/paper/en
- Tool `wjsw` (macOS arm64, Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64), library `libjsonw` with a stable C ABI, and SDKs for C, C++17,
  Python 3, Node.js, PHP 8, Go, Rust, Java 22+, Kotlin and Swift. Web servers (Apache, nginx, LiteSpeed, Caddy, IIS) via
  `wjsw-cgi`, with mandatory permission views.
- Databases: `wcon` converts PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Redis/Valkey and MongoDB to `.jsw` and back with no loss
  (schema taken from each column's type; numeric stays exact decimal; pgvector becomes vf32/vf16; values sent as bound data,
  never spliced into commands; credentials from files). `wremoto` reads a `.jsw` on R2, S3 or HTTP by Range, downloading
  only the needed blocks. Connectors ship for macOS and Linux (on Windows, via WSL).
- Node.js: `npm install @wortictecnologia/jsonw` (prebuilt addon for macOS arm64 and Linux x64, plus the `jsonw` CLI).
- Permissions inside the format: signed credential (HMAC-SHA256, constant-time, nonce + sequence), column scopes
  (`+escopo(x)`, `+pessoal`), row isolation by `tenant`, cell = both. Hidden data never leaves the server.
- Post-quantum: wire protocol over QUIC + TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768; custody and credentials use 256-bit hashes/HMAC.
- The schema and CLI use Portuguese words: texto, dinheiro, medida, codigo, tempo, dic, qualquer; ver, conferir, filtrar,
  calcular, comparar, avaliar, escolher, reconhecer.
